'''Ground Forces''' was an organization branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. They were responsible for law enforcement throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Ground Forces soldiers were known as [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]], commonly referred to as "Espos." They took orders directly from [[Locational Enforcement/Legends|Locational Enforcement]], [[Situational Enforcement/Legends|Situational Enforcement]], and [[Security Division Administration]], and some had been transferred to the [[Picket Fleet/Legends|Picket Fleet]] and [[Detention Taskforce]].<ref name="HSCS" />
